item.title: Hartanah Kenyalang secures RM275.3 mln contract for Sibu prison
item.description: KUCHING (Jan 31): ACE Market-listed Hartanah Kenyalang Bhd has secured a RM275.3 million design-and-build contract from the Public Works Department for a new prison in Sibu. Hartanah Kenyalang in a statement on Friday said the 36-month contract will commence on Feb 9, 2026, with completion and handover to the Public Works Department targeted for Feb 8, 2029. item.title: Another 6 e-waste containers weighing 158 tons were detained in Port Klang
item.description: PORT KLANG: Six containers containing scheduled electronic waste (e-waste) estimated to weigh 158,167 kilograms were seized at the West Port, here on Friday. The seizure was carried out as a result of a physical inspection of nine containers in an integrated multi-agency operation led by the Port Klang Border Control and Protection Agency (AKPS). item.description: ORLANDO, Fla., Jan. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Northern Jet closed 2025 with continued momentum across its operations, marked by fleet expansion, aircraft transactions, and steady growth in managed owner clients. item.title: The Agong officially approves the completion of BSAS Phase 1 conservation
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Yang di-Pertuan Agong, Sultan Ibrahim, consented to officiate the Completion Ceremony of the Conservation of the Sultan Abdul Samad Building (BSAS) Phase 1, here, today. item.title: MMEA detains log-laden cargo vessel off Bintulu for alleged flagging offence
item.description: BINTULU (Jan 31): A cargo vessel laden with logs was detained by the Malaysian Maritime Enforcement Agency (MMEA) Bintulu Maritime Zone for an alleged offence under the Merchant Shipping Ordinance (MSO) 1952.
